Q1.rationale: The NDA's compelled-disclosure carve-out refers to 'the requirements of paragraph 6' and paragraph 6(c) covers disclosure when legally required, but no text in the file states that the Recipient must notify the Discloser; the paragraph 6 notice language is not present.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Segment 61 bars disclosure of any Confidential Information or the existence of any dispute to any government agency or regulator without prior written consent; the only exceptions (segments 35, 71) cover information legally required to be disclosed, not voluntary reports of possible violations of law.
Q2.label: Entailment
